parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border/document friction or police targeting is documented, and same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2022 via a successful constitutional challenge, so no tier-1 universal exposure or organised targeting dominates. Against this, the record shows official and religious hostility, fundamentalist encouragement of discrimination, state scepticism toward LGBT migration, and no documented visitor-facing remedy or acceptance infrastructure. The sole documented trans violence is a single dated 2018 meat-cleaver attack; prosecution occurred but the 2019 sentence of $460 or three months with no jail time signals weak recourse, and a single old incident cannot establish a current rate. Employment exclusion of trans people is resident-facing climate only. Thin data on facilities, custody and current violence resolves below the 0.65 tier.
